key_insight: STEP3-VL-10B achieves near–frontier multimodal intelligence in a compact 10B model by combining unified, fully unfrozen pre-training with a scaled post-training pipeline, yielding strong intrinsic vision-language synergy.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between large, resource-heavy multimodal models and deployable lightweight models by improving multimodal reasoning and alignment in a 10B-parameter open-source foundation model.
method: Unified, fully unfrozen pre-training on 1.2T multimodal tokens to jointly learn vision-language representations.
Integrated language-aligned Perception Encoder paired with a Qwen3-8B decoder to establish intrinsic V-L synergy.
Scaled post-training pipeline with extensive multimodal tuning (over 1k post-training iterations) to refine capability and instruction alignment.
impact: Provides AI/ML practitioners a compact, open-source foundation model that reduces deployment cost while retaining strong multimodal performance—enabling faster iteration, fine-tuning, and edge/production use.
visual_elements: Architecture diagram: Perception Encoder → Qwen3-8B decoder showing unified, unfrozen training flow.
Data scale bar/chart: 1.2T multimodal tokens + post-training steps (≥1k) to convey training scale.
Performance vs model size plot: STEP3-VL-10B vs larger baselines to highlight efficiency gains.
Deployment icons: edge/cloud/latency/resource illustrations to show practical benefits of a 10B model.
paper_authors: Ailin Huang, Chengyuan Yao, Chunrui Han, Fanqi Wan, Hangyu Guo
